_comment: Copy to DIRECTOR/director_work.json. DeepSeek Harness edition: schema_version is the config format tools understand (1). Skipped in this edition: window (Claude context-window threshold; DSH compacts automatically), plugins_off, hooks, protect_director, director_worktree (Claude Code hook settings; DSH has no hooks). trace_id_pattern: regex for the requirement or decision IDs that work orders list in TRACES_TO; trace_report.py flags IDs that do not fit. Use the project's own IDs. mode: general or beginner, picked right after the starting prompt (docs/12); tools do not read it. po_pending_files / po_item_pattern / po_open_pattern: where metrics_report.py counts PO entries. verdict_self_check (2.3.0, optional): what gate_check --verdict does when a PASS-type verdict has no self-checked `- `<command>` exit=<n> at=<HH:MM>` line: "warn" (default in 2.3.x: a WARN note, exit code unchanged) or "fail" (the verdict fails); the default may become "fail" in 3.0.
_comment_safety: 2.2.5-ds.5 (docs/13): the safety gates of Standard/Strict orders, read by gate_check.py --order / --match (tools/safety_gate.py); every switch is on when missing. tests_first: TESTS_LOCKED with sha256; plan_gate: <WORK_DIR>/<WO>/PLAN.md approved by PLAN_APPROVED before code; spec_review_for_standard: SPEC_REVIEW for Standard too; stop_after_rounds: STOP_RULES at most this many rounds; prefer_auto: a note without an AUTO criterion. The lead may not turn one off: false (or 0) fails gate_check --order until a PO_PENDING entry naming the switch is answered by the PO. An old "sdd" block (ds.2-ds.4) is still read: its switches count with WARN 請搬到 safety, its OpenSpec keys are ignored with a WARN.
_comment_order_limits: 2.2.4-ds.4: the size of one Standard/Strict order, read by scope_check.py (tools/safety_gate.py). Test files (test_*.py, *_test.py, under tests/) count as files but their lines go to max_test_lines_per_order, not max_lines_per_order. 0 turns a limit off. An old sdd.max_files_per_order / sdd.max_lines_per_order is still read with a shadow WARN (move it here).
_comment_protected_tests: 2.2.4-ds.4: test files a worker may only add to (new file, or new tests at the end); changing existing content fails scope_check.py. TESTS_LOCKED files of an order are protected anyway. Globs relative to the project root.
_comment_resume: 2.2.2-ds.3 (upstream 2.2.2) RESUME_STATE size: max_bytes / max_line_bytes are read by gate_check --resume (shadow, --strict fails), dsh_setup_check and memory_size_check --kind resume. resume_archive.py never moves the newest keep_recent sections and Before: chain entries (by count, never by age; there is no keep_days) nor a section whose heading holds a protect_headings word (docs/06b).
_comment_base_ref: 2.2.2-ds.3 gate_check.py --order compares the order's BASE_REF commit with the remote branch. check: run it; fetch: git fetch first (false = compare with the local copy, said in the output); strict: a stale or missing BASE_REF or a failed fetch fails (same as --strict-base).
_comment_release: 2.2.2-ds.3 tools/release.py (optional; these are the defaults). title: {version} is filled in. selftest: a command line run in the repo. gh_repo: owner/name, null = from the remote URL.
